title: Synthetic reorder review
text: When synthetic stock is below the reorder point, review open purchase quantities and the sandbox lead time before proposing replenishment. A human must review any order. This is an invented policy, not ERP or company guidance.

title: Synthetic supplier review
text: Review unpaid overdue balances alongside open purchase orders for the same synthetic supplier. This is a review signal, not a credit rating or a recommendation to stop payments.
